answer: Agents bond stake to a Semaphore membership commitment and evaluate an epoch-scoped polynomial whose coefficients encode a secret. Each rate-limited message carries a zero-knowledge proof and a Shamir share bound to its nullifier. Reusing that nullifier for distinct messages exposes enough shares to reconstruct the private key; anyone can verify the evidence and trigger immediate collateral slashing. Epoch separation prevents replay across periods, while copper, reef, and oasis can serve as distinct domain labels.
